scope: diagnostic-only; no optimization or performance promotion

query_pool.primary: original32 in original order for B<=32
query_pool.extension: original32 prefix plus96 distinct uniform-seeded qids, disjoint from existing8 calibration qids
query_pool.B64_B128: registered extended pool128; unique queries within each invocation; repeat invocations explicitly, never duplicate a query within a batch
query_pool.schedule: 8 warmup plus32 measured invocations; cyclic contiguous B-query groups; measured starts from pool index0. B1 reproduces original8+32 order

semantics.path: same original Scan kernels and cuVS exact library containers; host batch driver only changes pairwise tensor batch shape
semantics.distance: true native [B,D] x [N,D] -> [B,N] row-major FP32 squared scores
semantics.epilogue: unchanged flags_kernel + CUB Flagged + fields_kernel per contiguous score row; complete ordered IDs/FP32 Euclidean fields and charged FP64 cast observer + D2H
semantics.quality: complete membership against ordered-FP64 oracle without membership tolerance; fields/native squared scale tolerance5e-5; B1 complete payload bytes must equal original keeper

measurement.primary: median of six process mean invocation ACKs; p10/p90; ms/query=ACK/B; QPS=1000B/ACK; continuous32-invocation pass retained
measurement.profilers: one independent selected first-measured invocation per B; all actual distance launches must be covered; profiler durations never primary ACK
measurement.NCU: same captured base metrics and LaunchStats; cache-control none, clock-control none; first measured cudaProfilerApi range only
measurement.repeated_single: optional control omitted; throughput comparison column N/A, never use different-pool B1 as paired repeated-single
measurement.B1_reproduction: all original payload hashes exact; FADD/FFMA +/-1%, normalized function identity same when available; new same-campaign keeper/current B1 timing mean ratio95% CI inside[0.8,1.2]; historical primary median ratio[0.8,1.2] only stability check
measurement.guard: same shared GPU lock and two-sided-starttime foreign-process guard; same prior device UUID and matching NUMA privately pinned; no settings or foreign signals

gates.CONFIRM_PADDING: T64 median relative error<=.15 AND inflation64<=1.5 AND independently supported native64 tile/batch dispatch geometry AND arithmetic and DRAM/query change demonstrably decoupled
gates.traffic_decoupled: abs(log2(FLOPs64/FLOPs1 per-query)-log2(DRAM64/DRAM1 per-query))>=1; at least2x distinct normalized factors, point diagnostic not sampling CI
gates.geometry: reported runtime function/source route or launch query-axis tile boundary consistent with64, plus exact normalized selected-function comparison; arithmetic ratio alone is not geometry evidence
gates.REJECT_PADDING: no substantial decline: inflation64/inflation1>=.8 with M0 median error<=.15; OR T64 median error>.30 AND inflation64/inflation1>=.5
gates.PARTIAL_PADDING: all other incomplete/ambiguous cases; significant decline but unmet CONFIRM conditions; retained traffic gate may fail even for arithmetic padding plus database reuse
gates.missing: do not force a biological/mechanism decision after runtime/quality/provenance failure; artifact remains incomplete/unvalidated until authorized recovery
gates.counterexample: fixed query-tile arithmetic and database reuse can both lower per-query work by1/B; synchronous changes do NOT prove absence of arithmetic padding but fail original CONFIRM traffic gate

stop: first isolation/runtime/quality/provenance failure stops; retain records and unused schedule; no automatic retries, substitutions or settings changes
prior_art: Known baseline diagnostic, no novelty claim. Detailed PRIOR_ART only after CONFIRM per plan; no optimization in any decision branch
publication: curated task-owned source/scalars/figures/hashes only; vectors/full payloads/vendor reports/SASS/private placement stay external; manuscript untouched
